items.source: Note: This listener should be placed before ContextLoaderListener in web.xml, at least when used for log4j. Log4jConfigListener sets the system property implicitly, so there's no need for this listener in addition to it.
items.translation: 注意：此监听器应放置在 `web.xml` 中的 `ContextLoaderListener` 之前，至少在用于 log4j 时如此。Log4jConfigListener 会隐式设置系统属性，因此无需额外添加此监听器。

items.source: WARNING: Some containers, for example, Tomcat, do NOT keep system properties separate per web app. You have to use unique "webAppRootKey" context-params per web app then, to avoid clashes. Other containers do isolate each web app's system properties: Here you can use the default key (i.e. no "webAppRootKey" context-param at all) without worrying.
items.translation: 警告：某些容器（例如 Tomcat）不会按 Web 应用程序单独保留系统属性。为避免冲突，您必须为每个 Web 应用程序使用唯一的"webAppRootKey"上下文参数。其他容器则会隔离每个 Web 应用程序的系统属性：在此情况下，您可以使用默认键（即完全不设置"webAppRootKey"上下文参数），无需担心。

items.source: WARNING: The WAR file containing the web application needs to be expanded to allow for setting the web app root system property. This is by default not the case when a WAR file gets deployed to WebLogic, for example. Do not use this listener in such an environment!
items.translation: 警告：包含 Web 应用程序的 WAR 文件需要被展开，以便设置 Web 应用根系统属性。例如，当 WAR 文件部署到 WebLogic 时，默认情况下并非如此。请勿在此类环境中使用该监听器！

items.source:
Can be used for toolkits that support substitution with system properties
(i.e. System.getProperty values), like log4j's "${key}" syntax within log
file locations.
items.translation: 可用于支持使用系统属性（即 `System.getProperty` 值）进行替换的工具包，例如在日志文件位置中使用 log4j 的 `"${key}"` 语法。
